ns2:section.sectionText: This section meets in-person. Registration restricted to Gies College of Business majors and Ag ACCY majors. Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
